purpose: Matched target ablation: identical model, loss, training-image selection and decoder, but the second head learns all nucleus contours instead of only nucleus-nucleus contacts.
augmentation: Uniform 90-degree rotations and independent horizontal and vertical flips with probability 0.5.
selection: Fixed final epoch; contact threshold and minimum instance size selected using official training images only; test images decoded once.
primary_endpoint: Bilkent nucleus-level micro F1, reported separately for Huh7 and HepG2.
published_comparator: AttentionBoost: Huh7 F1 0.954 +/- 0.005; HepG2 F1 0.919 +/- 0.008 over five runs.
